Advertisement for Associate Professor in Radiotherapy
Saturday, 21 July 2018
4353 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the post of Associate Professor in Radiotherapy. The applicant should attend the walk-in-interview along with complete biodata with necessary academic certificates/testimonial  on 03/08/2018 at 3 PM in the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, Wardha. The appointments would be adhoc till the next Selection Committee of MUHS meets.
Qualification: MBBS with MCI recognized Post-graduate Degree in concerned subject.
Experience : As per MCI and MUHS norms
Pay Scale : As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society
For more details please contact:
Phone: 07152 -284341 to 284355 (Ext. 203) fax: 07152-284333, 284220
Email:
khssgm@rediffmail.com
Website: www.mgims.ac.in
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
